title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Soda True Mix Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co’s tributes to classic soda drinks wouldn’t be complete without True Mix, a delicious beverage flavour inspired by Scotland’s favourite fizzy pop! Sweet and refreshing – and a little bit sassy – True Mix will put a smile on any vaper’s face. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices . Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
